content:
Apple One offers a bundle of popular Apple services at a discounted price, and in iOS 27, the premium Premier plan will gain several new advantages.

Apple One Premier is getting two upgrades in iOS 27, both related to Apple Intelligence

If you're an Apple One user looking for one more reason to upgrade to Apple One Premier, iOS 27 might just give you that reason.

The new iPhone software brings two upgrades to the high-tier Apple One plan.

  • Apple Home AI features
  • Higher image generation usage limits and more

Apple's Home app will be adding several AI features in iOS 27, some of which are limited to 2TB iCloud+ subscribers. That means you'll need Apple One Premier or the top standalone iCloud+ plan to access them.

It's still unclear whether all or just some of the AI features will require a subscription. The iOS 27 beta notes only state: 'Apple Intelligence for Home requires an iCloud+ subscription of 2TB or more.'

However, the upgraded HomeKit Secure Video features will very likely require at least the premium plan, including automatic video description generation, clip search, and highlight reel surfacing.

If you're looking for a camera that supports HomeKit Secure Video, here are my recommendations:

  • Aqara G100 2K Security Camera: Priced at just $35, it's an extremely cost-effective choice
  • eufy 4K Security Camera: Supports 4K resolution but is priced higher at $59

Additionally, some new AI features in iOS 27 (such as image generation) have daily usage caps. Apple One Premier subscribers will enjoy higher caps, according to Apple:

The iCloud+ plan included with Apple One's Individual tier does not qualify. So if you want higher AI usage limits, that's another reason to choose Apple One Premier.

Apple One starts at $19.95 per month and includes Apple TV, Apple Music, iCloud+, and other services.
